title: WeatherObservationSchema
description: Standardized schema for normalized weather observations at field GPS coordinates.

temperature_mean.description: Mean ambient temperature in Celsius over recent 7 days.

humidity_mean.description: Mean relative humidity percentage over recent 7 days.

rainfall_7d.description: Cumulative precipitation in mm over recent 7 days.

rainfall_14d.description: Cumulative precipitation in mm over recent 14 days.

source.description: Weather data provider (e.g. Open-Meteo, OpenWeatherMap, Cached, Offline-Fallback).

is_available.description: Flag indicating whether actual meteorological observations were retrieved.
